{{Quote|To be opened in the presence of Leia Organa Solo, self-styled Chief of State of the so-called New Republic, Han Solo, and the de facto governor-general of the Corellian Sector, Code Rogue Angel Seven.|the message Pharnis Gleary delivered to the Solos|<ref name="Ambush at Corellia">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
'''Pharnis Gleasry''' was a shady agent for the [[Human League]] as of [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]].

==Biography==
He spied on [[Chief of State (New Republic)/Legends|Chief of State]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] as she departed for the Corellian Trade Summit and was a key member of the [[Corellian Crisis|Corellian Insurrection]] conspiracy. He obtained Organa Solo's main message frequency and sent a coded message to Organa Solo through [[Smugglers' Alliance]] trader, [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]], though his first choice was [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]].

He was arrested following the conclusion of the Corellian Crisis.
